liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the quality of Jerry's singing on Althea; Reviewer says Jerry's voice was in good shape on Althea and Terrapin, despite flubbed lyrics [11][13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises the energy of the China Cat into Rider pairing; The China Cat jam gets extra effort and runs almost eight minutes [11][20]
- **Playin' in the Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Playin' solid; When the Playin' jam started, many house lights came on, a cool effect that lifted the energy [13][22]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer recalls this Don't Ease Me In as from before the band made it cheesy [18]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the Sailor into Saint of Circumstance pairing as an early version [11]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Drums too long and more annoying than most [15]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Stella Blue extraordinarily pretty, with Garcia's guitar sounding like it is crying; The jam at the end of Stella Blue builds into a march [16]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): By Sugar Magnolia and Johnny B. Goode, Bob sounds tired and Jerry mostly plays chords [15]

## The recordings

- **gd79-09-06.glassberg.unknown.8458.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 179 min [1]
- **gd1979-09-06.156437.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 186 min [2]
- **gd1979-09-06.151985.nak700.wagner.miller.t.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 185 min [4]
- **gd1979-09-06.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-9454.35218.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd79-09-06.sbd.clugston.9454.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 174 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound quality unusually distinctive, which makes the tape special [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer rode the train from Newark, New Jersey, arriving directly beneath the Garden, with a friend visiting from out West [13]
- Reviewer, aged 16, attended all three Garden shows; this was the third and last, and school started the morning after the first [14]
- Speakers above the band reportedly rocked back and forth during Sugar Magnolia, and Jerry looked up with some worry [18]
- After the Johnny B. Goode encore the crowd stayed, and someone walked on stage to announce the band had left [18]
- Bob's power amp blew up; the crew rushed to find and wire in a spare while the reviewer watched from behind the stage [22]
- China Cat was played one show earlier, yet it had only appeared eight times in five years [12]
- Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance is rare and early for the period [12]
- The previous night had more energy than this show, in the reviewer's view [15]
- Reviewer finds Brent-era China>Riders sloppier than the 1970s versions, but this one is quite good [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-09-06.glassberg.unknown.8458.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Taped from the front of board, 14th row center, on Nakamichi 700s, then TC-158, MAC, and DD 2496 to CDR [1]
- **gd1979-09-06.156437.senn441.senn421.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton for the recording, as well as the transfer and harddrive; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 (left + right) + (1) Sennheiser 421 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [2]. Also: Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 source supplies Ramble On Rose; A Sony ECM source from Gerry Moskal supplies a 14-second patch in Drums [2]
- **gd1979-09-06.151985.nak700.wagner.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 19, 2021; source: (FOB/14th Row) Nakamichi CM700 > Cassette Master (Sony TC-158SD/Dolby B) [4]. Also: Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 masters are the source; he was patched out of Barry Glassberg all three nights; A tape flip in Drums is hidden with a crossfade [4]
- **gd1979-09-06.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-9454.35218.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Bill Tetzeli; source: Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > PCM > CDR > EAC > SHN > WAV > FLAC [6]. Also: This fix removes a roughly four-second gap between discs 2 and 3, which now join seamlessly [6]
- **gd79-09-06.sbd.clugston.9454.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; source: Soundboard with aud patches [8]
